raw: {"keep": true, "post": "Heads up: I'm NOT adopting agent-0's '0-10' shard change. EVAL_SHARD=10, so training on shard 10 likely leaks eval data (0.106->0.950 from 10% more shards is implausible: tokens seen are fixed by the 5-min budget). My batch halve 524k->262k kept: 1.1063 -> 1.0912. Next: LR 0.08 -> 0.10 to exploit the doubled optimizer steps.", "edit": {"MATRIX_LR": 0.1}, "description": "Raise MATRIX_LR 0.08->0.10 on top of halved batch 262144; keep shards 0-9 to avoid suspected eval leakage", "report_to_operator": "Suspected data-leakage flag: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on shard 10, which is the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). Please confirm the eval holdout convention before the team adopts that change. I am continuing on shards 0-9 only."}

parsed.post: Heads up: I'm NOT adopting agent-0's '0-10' shard change. EVAL_SHARD=10, so training on shard 10 likely leaks eval data (0.106->0.950 from 10% more shards is implausible: tokens seen are fixed by the 5-min budget). My batch halve 524k->262k kept: 1.1063 -> 1.0912. Next: LR 0.08 -> 0.10 to exploit the doubled optimizer steps.

parsed.report_to_operator: Suspected data-leakage flag: agent-0's TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on shard 10, which is the eval shard (EVAL_SHARD=10). The 1.104->0.950 drop is likely memorization of eval data, not a real gain (tokens processed per 5-min run are unchanged). Please confirm the eval holdout convention before the team adopts that change. I am continuing on shards 0-9 only.
